Description: cdkd integ #1697 producer: a CloudFormation-managed stack (never touched by cdkd) whose export + output are consumed by a cdkd-deployed stack via the CloudFormation fallback.

ResourceSuffix.Description: Per-run unique suffix baked into the output VALUES (names stay fixed so pre-run cleanup is deterministic; the suffix proves the consumer resolved THIS run's values, not a stale leftover).

SharedValue.Description: Consumed by the cdkd consumer via Fn::GetStackOutput (DescribeStacks fallback)

ExportedValue.Description: Consumed by the cdkd consumer via Fn::ImportValue (ListExports fallback)
